source: docs/research/vibe-tone-music.md (2026-09-29): §5.1-§5.7 and §6 transcribed verbatim; the tables after SOURCES are WS-VIBE transcriptions of prose (§2, §3.1, §4) and derived niche/product sets

raw-ugc.description: Lo-fi phone footage, handheld, natural light, talking to a friend. Native grammar in a real room with candid delivery.

look.lighting: window daylight or room practicals; uneven light is fine as long as the face reads
look.grade: phone default, slightly warm white balance; no LUT, no crushed contrast
look.set: a real lived-in room (kitchen counter, car, bathroom, desk), tidied but real
look.wardrobe: everyday casual, solid colours, no visible logos

camera.style: selfie or handheld phone at eye level, one-take feel
camera.lens: phone main camera (~24-26 mm equiv.) or selfie camera (~23 mm)

text_style.placement: upper-centre band y 288-700, never over the face

do: open mid-action with hands on the product
keep one visible imperfection (RULES C1/C6)
talk to one person, not an audience
show the product more than once (Meta x Toluna 2.7x)
dont: no studio light or seamless backdrop
no stock-footage inserts
no trending song outside the licensed library
no shaky footage in the TikTok Shop lane (stabilise)

presenter_notes.ai: Not recommended: DEFAULT_VIBE swaps it to clean-aesthetic. Candid grammar is the human lane (C6), and faked shake on an AI render adds detectable-flaw eeriness (F133).
presenter_notes.human: Default human lane. Add at least 2 candid cues: handheld micro-shake, uneven natural light, a mid-sentence punch-in (C6).

clean-aesthetic.description: Minimal set, soft even light, neutral palette, calm confidence. Polished but not glossy; the product is the only focal point.

look.lighting: large soft key (window or diffused softbox), low contrast, no hard shadows
look.grade: clean, neutral-warm white balance, low saturation, slightly lifted blacks
look.set: minimal surface with 1-3 props and negative space, in the product's colour family (B19)
look.wardrobe: neutral knit or linen, no patterns, no logos

camera.style: tripod or gimbal, symmetrical framing, product centred

text_style.placement: lower-middle band y 700-1248 with generous margins

do: one idea per shot
leave negative space for text
one macro texture insert
keep the voice warm and volume-varied, not flat (Van Zant & Berger)
dont: no clutter or busy patterns
no heavy LUT or teal-orange
no risers or hype SFX
no more than one emoji on screen

presenter_notes.ai: Preferred AI lane: clean framing hides render flaws. Lock the persona's face and set from video 1 (RULES §4).
presenter_notes.human: Suits creators with an aesthetic account style. Keep one candid moment so it does not read as a TV ad.

hype-energy.description: Fast cuts, bold text, upbeat music, high-energy delivery. A selling tool: strong for gadgets and quick wins, but it costs brand memory when it is all salesmanship.

look.lighting: bright high-key and punchy; one coloured accent light allowed
look.set: clean backdrop or bold colour wall, product in hand
look.wardrobe: bold solid colour that contrasts with the backdrop

camera.style: dynamic: fast angle changes, product close to the lens

text_style.placement: upper-centre band y 288-700, pops on the beat

do: cut on the beat
add one showmanship device: a character, story turn or hummable hook (System1)
make the payoff the single loudest moment
slow the VO on the proof line (B11)
dont: no more than 8 cuts per 10 s (Xiao inverted-U)
no wall-to-wall hype: dip the energy once before the payoff (A6)
no finance or health claims in this vibe
no VO above 190 wpm

presenter_notes.ai: Utilitarian gadgets only. Keep the synthetic voice calm-confident rather than shouty: energetic synthetic reads were rated worse (Frontiers 2023).
presenter_notes.human: Get energy from movement and cuts, not shouting. Loud-then-soft volume variation reads as confidence (Van Zant & Berger 2020).

cozy-calm.description: Warm low light, slow pacing, soft voice, low-tempo music bed. Comfort and ritual; sells feeling and texture.

look.lighting: warm practicals (bedside lamp, string lights, candle-look) at 2700-3200 K with soft fall-off
look.grade: warm, soft contrast, gentle grain; natural skin
look.set: bed, sofa, blanket, mug, window at dusk
look.wardrobe: soft knits or loungewear in muted tones

camera.lens: 35-50 mm equiv., shallow depth of field

text_style.placement: lower-middle band y 900-1248 on a soft plate

do: use fewer words and longer pauses rather than slower speech
every shot over 3.5 s names push-in or tilt (D48)
let one real sound breathe (steam, fabric)
keep the tone warm-affiliative (B18)
dont: no risers, impact hits or whip-pans
no bright overhead light
no speech below 150 wpm (gate floor)
no urgency or scarcity language (A3)

presenter_notes.ai: Hedonic lane, so a human is preferred (F32). If AI, keep it product-led, with hands and objects rather than the face.
presenter_notes.human: Best in the human lane. A whisper-soft register is allowed for self-care products (RULES §3, d=0.38) if every word stays intelligible.

expert-trust.description: Steady medium shots, clear labels, measured authoritative delivery. Evidence first; the presenter explains how and why.

look.lighting: neutral 5000-5600 K key plus fill; even face light; no hard shadows
look.set: clean workbench, desk or counter with real tools; labels and readouts legible
look.wardrobe: plain crew or collared top, solid colour, no logos

camera.style: tripod at eye level; MCU/MS on the presenter, ECU inserts on proof

text_style.placement: lower label bar y 900-1248; numbers set large

do: state strong facts plainly (B1)
end claims on a falling contour (Vaughan-Johnston 2024)
show the measurement, not just the verdict
use a medium shot for price or guarantee lines (§5)
dont: no jokes on proof lines (humour lowers source credibility, Eisend 2009)
no red in finance price graphics (B16)
no extreme close-up of the face on high-trust claims
no 'I tested it' from an AI persona (FTC 465)

presenter_notes.ai: Strong AI lane for utilitarian or high-complexity products (B15): the persona explains the mechanism and never claims personal experience.
presenter_notes.human: Mention credentials only if they are real. Similarity still beats status (§5), so keep it conversational.

playful-comedic.description: Quick punchlines, reaction shots, meme timing. The product causes the joke; entertainment carries memory and conversion.

sfx: a beat of silence before the punchline

look.set: a real home or workplace with the props the gag needs
look.wardrobe: casual and colourful; a character costume is allowed

camera.style: reaction coverage (MCU plus wide), POV skits

text_style.placement: meme caption at the top band y 288-600

do: make the product cause the punchline
hold 0.4-0.6 s of silence before the payoff line
include a reaction face (RULES C4)
escalate across 3 beats (C2)
dont: no jokes on price, guarantee or proof lines
never in finance or health-claim scripts
no punching down or stereotypes
no scripted laughter (F142)

presenter_notes.ai: Deadpan only, because a flat AI affect reads as intentional. Never an AI 'confession' gag (D137).
presenter_notes.human: Best in the human lane. Overlapping two-person dialogue is the scriptable stand-in for real chemistry (RULES §9 killed list).

cinematic-premium.description: Macro and slow motion, dramatic light, product as hero. VO is sparse; music and light do the persuading.

look.lighting: low-key: hard side or back light, rim light, controlled reflections, dark backdrop
look.grade: rich contrast, deep blacks, filmic highlight roll-off; a cool-to-warm shift on narrative beats only (System1 2026)
look.set: seamless dark sweep; stone, marble or wet surface
look.wardrobe: hands only, or black or neutral sleeves

camera.style: macro plus slow motion with a motion-control feel

text_style.placement: centre of the safe box, one card at a time, wide letter-spacing

do: speak the product name at the visual transient (A4)
one hero reveal, at the payoff
show the brand in context, never a bare logo (System1: bare logo -30% awareness lift)
keep VO under ~40% of runtime
dont: no hard sell or discount shouting
no stock clichés (splashes unrelated to the product)
no grade shift across before/after evidence
no more than 3 words per card

presenter_notes.ai: Good AI lane when the persona is mostly off-screen (VO plus hands). The render must be flawless (F133).
presenter_notes.human: The human appears as VO or hands. Keep one human-scale shot so it does not read as a TV spot.

asmr-satisfying.description: Close-up textures and real product sound, with little or no music. The sound is the soundtrack; words are sparse and captioned.

sfx: close-mic product sounds: click, pour, peel, crinkle, snap, fizz
no added foley the product cannot make

look.lighting: soft top or side light for texture; high-CRI, flicker-free
look.set: a tidy surface: organiser, restock or cleaning scene in close-up
look.wardrobe: hands only; neat nails; no jewellery that clinks

camera.style: overhead or POV close-up, locked off or slow drift

text_style.placement: top band y 288-500, away from the action

do: record real sound close-mic in a quiet room (TikTok Shop audio rule)
complete the satisfying action on screen as the payoff
caption the one key claim
keep speech under ~40% of runtime
dont: no music over the key sound
no whisper so slow it falls below the 2.5 w/s gate
no fake or exaggerated foley that misrepresents the product
no fast cuts that break the action

presenter_notes.ai: Good AI lane (hands and product, little face). Disclose if the hands are AI-rendered.
presenter_notes.human: Human hands. A whisper VO is allowed for self-care products (RULES §3).

story-vlog.description: Selfie and walk-and-talk diary in the present tense, with day markers. The viewer lives the streak or the day alongside the presenter.

look.lighting: available light across locations; daylight and golden hour welcome
look.grade: natural with light warmth, consistent across days
look.set: several real locations plus one anchor spot revisited every day
look.wardrobe: a different outfit each day (a day cue), same hair and face

camera.style: selfie-stick or handheld walk-and-talk with POV inserts

text_style.placement: day marker top-left of the safe box (x 120-500, y 288-420); captions mid-frame

do: present tense, first person (human only)
put day markers on screen
include one setback beat (C1)
let the product cause a story turn (B8)
dont: no AI presenter (story formats are human-only, D137)
no 'results' without showing the middle (B9)
no health or weight-loss outcome claims
no grade that shifts from day to day

presenter_notes.ai: Not allowed: DEFAULT_VIBE swaps it to clean-aesthetic. Story-time and confession are human-only (D137), and human narrators out-persuade AI ones on narrative (IJHCI 2024).
presenter_notes.human: Default for challenge and routine concepts. Conversational co-experience delivery (F45).

before-after-reveal.description: Transformation first, with matched framing; the gap is the star. Show the after, rewind to how, then show the middle.

genres: pop build with a drop at the reveal
sfx: shutter click on the after frame

look.lighting: IDENTICAL setup for before and after: same position, time of day and white balance
look.grade: one grade for both halves; no change in grade, exposure or filter between them
look.set: locked-off framing on the same marks; the after is shot from the same angle
look.wardrobe: identical in both halves unless the wardrobe is the product

camera.lens: same focal length for both halves

text_style.placement: BEFORE/AFTER labels at the top of each half, y 288-420

do: show the after in frame 0 (RULES §6)
script 1-2 middle progression beats (B9)
keep the gap visible at thumbnail size
label the time span (DAY 1 to DAY 7)
dont: no lighting, grade or angle change that fakes the result (TikTok ad policy; FTC)
no unsupported transformation claims (TikTok Shop)
no weight-loss before/after
no beauty filter on either half

presenter_notes.ai: Allowed for product transformations (cleaning, organising). The AI never claims its own body or skin changed.
presenter_notes.human: Best for personal transformations. Disclose the time span and keep lighting identical.

pack_pattern.apply_if: current vibe == 'raw-ugc' AND the pattern is the research pack's top pattern with share >= 0.25

utilitarian.music_bias: steady, clean beds; no sentimental or nostalgic moods

hedonic.music_bias: warm, sensory beds; product sound up

duration.pacing: use the upper half of target_wpm; pattern_interrupt_s = min(profile, 3)
at least two energy dips (A6); pattern_interrupt_s = min(profile, 6)

constraints: default tone is one of warm, confident, calm, expert, deadpan, playful
excited and empathetic only in restricted form: excited on reveal lines, empathetic in third person, never as testimonial or confession
a vibe whose default tone is excited switches to confident
fit = hedonic keeps the vibe but raises fit_warning (F32)
raw-ugc and story-vlog carry at least 2 candid cues (C6)

warm.description: Friendly, affiliative, agreement-rich; a friend recommending something. The default tone (RULES B18).
warm.delivery_notes: Smile in the voice with moderate pitch variation. Vary volume slightly (confidence cue) and end claims on a falling contour.
phrasing_tips: no hedging on the proof line
warm.ai_notes: Safe default for AI personas. Avoid over-bright, high pitch, and keep one consistent voice (RULES §3).

confident.description: Assured and direct without dominance; certainty comes from specifics.
confident.delivery_notes: Slightly louder, with deliberate volume variation (Van Zant & Berger 2020). Falling intonation at the end of claims (Vaughan-Johnston 2024). Slow down on the strongest line (B11).
phrasing_tips: a concrete number or test in the line
one command at most, never stacked (B18)
confident.ai_notes: Allowed. Keep it calm-confident rather than salesy; a synthetic hard-sell read is disliked (Frontiers 2023).

excited.description: High-arousal enthusiasm reserved for genuine reveals.
excited.delivery_notes: Wider pitch range and faster pace, but peaks only at the payoff. Drop to warm right after it (A1 post-peak buffer).
phrasing_tips: at most one exclamation per 10 s
excited.ai_notes: Use sparingly. Energetic synthetic reads were rated worse than calm ones. Never an excited testimonial: an AI cannot claim use or experience (FTC 465).

calm.delivery_notes: Softer intensity and clear articulation (quieter, clearer voices were preferred, JTR 2023). Pause about 0.3-0.5 s between sentences. Cut words instead of slowing below 150 wpm.
calm.ai_notes: The best-performing style for synthetic voices (Frontiers 2023). Keep pitch variation moderate, not monotone (JTAER 2026 inverted-U).

deadpan.description: Flat, understated delivery where the visual contradicts the words; comedy through restraint.
deadpan.delivery_notes: Narrow pitch range with crisp timing. Hold 0.4-0.6 s of silence before the punchline; never laugh at your own line (F142).
deadpan.ai_notes: Well suited to AI: flat affect reads as intentional rather than uncanny.

expert.description: Measured authority that explains mechanism and evidence.
expert.delivery_notes: Measured pace, falling intonation, stress on numbers and units. Pause before the key figure; slow targeted words, not the whole line (arXiv 2603.30032).
expert.ai_notes: A strong AI lane for utilitarian and high-complexity products (B15). Explain; never claim personal testing.

playful.description: Teasing, light and bouncy; invites the viewer into the joke.
playful.delivery_notes: Bouncy pitch and a smile in the voice, with quick back-and-forth rhythm and callbacks.
phrasing_tips: a callback to the hook at the CTA
playful.ai_notes: Light touch only. Humour costs source credibility (Eisend 2009), so keep the product claim outside the joke.

empathetic.description: Validating and gentle; names the viewer's frustration without shaming.
empathetic.delivery_notes: Softer and a little lower in pitch, slowing on the pain point, then lifting into the solution (gain frame, A3).
phrasing_tips: no fear appeals or body shaming
empathetic.ai_notes: No 'I've been there' from an AI persona (FTC 465: no experience claims). Use 'a lot of people…' and let a human carry confession beats (D137).

scale.1: still: bed barely audible, locked shot
scale.4: high: music forward, faster cuts, pitch-varied VO
scale.5: peak: single transient (reveal, drop or hit), then a 0.8 s low-information buffer (A1)

vo_rule_by_energy.4: brisk, pitch-varied (unless the vibe's gate_wps is 2.5)
vo_rule_by_energy.5: 'Slow down. Let the result land.' on the claim (B11); energy comes from picture and music

rules: exactly one beat reaches the curve's maximum, and it is the PAYOFF (a single peak, A6/A7)
at least one beat before the DEMO or PAYOFF sits at least 1 below the hook (the dip, A6)
CTA energy is at least 2, at most the PAYOFF energy, and gain-framed (A3)
the beats actually in the script use at least 3 distinct energy levels, so the curve is never flat (indifference is the enemy: dull ads convert 27% worse, System1)
after any energy-5 beat, no payload (price, name, link) for 0.8 s (A1)
keep BPM fixed within a track; express energy through stems, ducking depth and cuts, and change track only at the PAYOFF

principles: music is added at upload, per platform; the render master carries VO + SFX + room tone only
CML is TikTok-only and Meta Sound Collection is Meta-only; one master needs per-platform music or a third-party licence that names every platform plus paid media
never reuse another creator's original audio in commercial content
log {platform, account_type, lane, library, track_id, date, placements} in the manifest

third-party track licensed for TikTok commercial use (keep proof)

cross-posting the CML track to Reels or Shorts

flags: AI-generated content disclaimer if any audio is AI

never: in-app licensed songs in product-promoting posts (personal-use licence; detail UNVERIFIED)
flags: paid partnership label if a brand is involved
AI info label for realistic AI audio or video
paid partnership label for affiliate or gifted posts

never: copyrighted in-app music (makes the Reel ineligible for boosting)
flags: Partnership Ads format for creator content (UNVERIFIED primary)

also_ok: third-party track licensed for Instagram commercial use
never: in-app licensed songs in branded or affiliate Reels
flags: AI info label for realistic AI audio or video

ads.library: Meta Sound Collection or Ads Manager royalty-free music

also_ok: third-party track licensed for Instagram commercial use
flags: AI info label for realistic AI audio or video

ads.library: Ads Manager royalty-free music or Meta Sound Collection

also_ok: track cleared for commercial use on YouTube

also_ok: track cleared for commercial use on YouTube
never: Shorts Audio Library label music in branded Shorts

ads.library: YouTube Audio Library or fully cleared licensed music

also_ok: track cleared for commercial use on YouTube
never: Shorts Audio Library label music (commercial channel)

ads.library: YouTube Audio Library or fully cleared licensed music

any ad unless the AI disclaimer is set and the licence covers paid media
requirements: generated on a paid plan with commercial rights, download receipt logged (Suno: paid-plan downloads only since 2026-09-03)
no imitation of a real artist or voice
expect no copyright ownership of pure AI output (USCO 2025; Thaler cert denied 2026-03-02)

PROPOSED_RULES.name: vibe_speech_rate
PROPOSED_RULES.check: If vibe.pacing.gate_wps == 2.5 or beat energy <= 2, every spoken beat's delivery contains a SLOW_KEY. The rendered per-turn wpm (Muse Voice Transcribe ENDPOINTING) lies within vibe.target_wpm +/- 10.
PROPOSED_RULES.threshold: fail: any turn > 200 wpm, or a slow-vibe beat without a SLOW_KEY; warn: outside target +/- 10

PROPOSED_RULES.name: energy_curve_shape
PROPOSED_RULES.check: Compute ENERGY_CURVE.by_vibe over the script's beats.
PROPOSED_RULES.threshold: fail: the maximum is not a single beat at PAYOFF, CTA is outside [2, PAYOFF], or fewer than 3 distinct levels; warn: no beat before PAYOFF sits at least 1 below the hook (fix by adding an EDUCATION or EVIDENCE beat)

PROPOSED_RULES.name: music_lane_valid
PROPOSED_RULES.check: direction.music.library is in MUSIC_LICENSING[platform][account][lane].library or also_ok. The music block names no song titles or artists. The licence-log keys are present.
PROPOSED_RULES.threshold: fail on any mismatch or a named commercial song

PROPOSED_RULES.name: music_not_baked
PROPOSED_RULES.check: The render brief asks for a music-free master plus a guide mix; the final music is added at upload.
PROPOSED_RULES.threshold: fail if the brief tells the video agent to add a final commercial track
source: Instagram: Sound Collection for Facebook and Instagram videos

PROPOSED_RULES.name: ai_audio_disclosure
PROPOSED_RULES.check: AI music or AI voice sets the platform flags: YouTube AI use = Yes, TikTok ads AIGC disclaimer, Meta AI info. There is no AI music in TikTok commercial or Shop lanes, and presenter=ai is never in the TikTok Shop lane.
PROPOSED_RULES.threshold: fail if any flag is missing or a blocked lane is used

PROPOSED_RULES.name: music_vibe_congruence
PROPOSED_RULES.check: music.bpm is within vibe.bpm +/- 10 and music.moods overlaps vibe.moods. Hedonic fit gets no 'steady/neutral' bed; utilitarian fit gets no 'nostalgic' bed. asmr-satisfying ducks music at least 18 dB under the product sound, or uses no music.
PROPOSED_RULES.threshold: warn on mismatch; fail if the legacy 'neutral upbeat' bed ships with cozy-calm, asmr-satisfying or cinematic-premium

PROPOSED_RULES.name: text_legibility
PROPOSED_RULES.check: Frame-0 text is at most 3 words, UPPER, no emoji. Other cards have at most vibe.max_words_per_card words, and cards over 3 words use sentence or lower case. Contrast is at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large bold). Line height is at least 75 px, at most 25 chars per line and 3 lines, and at most 1 emoji per card.
PROPOSED_RULES.threshold: fail: frame-0 or contrast violations; warn: the rest

PROPOSED_RULES.name: before_after_lock
PROPOSED_RULES.check: Every BEFORE/AFTER pair shares identical lighting, grade, lens, angle and white-balance tokens, with no filter on either half.

PROPOSED_RULES.name: presenter_voice_lane
PROPOSED_RULES.check: For presenter=ai, the voice spec says 'synthetic' and 'disclosed', the bundle never says 'human voice only', the tone is not an excited testimonial or empathetic confession, and the vibe is not story-vlog.

PROPOSED_RULES.name: showmanship_device
PROPOSED_RULES.check: Scripts that are hype-energy or salesmanship-heavy (split-screen, facts and CTA together) contain at least 1 showmanship device: a story turn, a character, a reaction face, a hummable hook, a soft voice or pause, or an out-of-the-ordinary moment.
source: System1 x TikTok 2025-26 (showmanship +50% conversion lift, salesmanship -50% brand awareness lift)

VIBES.tutorial-screen: screen-record or whiteboard explainer for apps, finance and education; the cursor and numbers are the stars
VIBES.retro-nostalgic: Y2K, VHS or film-grain look with period-style music; trend lane, hedonic products

TONES.hushed: whisper/ASMR register for self-care (RULES §3 whisper-flow); 150-160 wpm, delivery_key 'unhurried'
TONES.curious: investigative, question-led delivery for curiosity-gap hooks; 160-175 wpm

ai.voice_source: One locked, licensed, consented synthetic voice per persona; never a clone of a real person without written consent (Muse AUP bans unconsented cloning and passing outputs off as human; agent-runtime.md B8)
ai.spec: Natural-prosody synthetic voice, disclosed; no robotic cadence; never claims to be human
ai.pace_control: Set the TTS rate so output lands at 155-175 wpm. Put pauses in text (commas, em-dashes) or SSML <break time="300ms"/> at beat seams (matches timing.PAUSE=0.3). Stress keywords; end claims on a falling contour
ai.lanes: Utilitarian or high-complexity products; not the TikTok Shop lane (AI voices banned in LIVE, reportedly in shoppable videos); ads need the AIGC disclaimer
ai.qa: Run Muse Voice Transcribe in ENDPOINTING mode on the render: wpm per turn = words / (endMs - startMs) x 60,000. Fail if any turn is above 200 wpm; warn below 140 (agent-runtime.md B3/C3; per-turn only, no word timestamps). Muse has no TTS endpoint, so voices come from an external engine (UNVERIFIED which)

human.voice_source: The creator's own voice; a second voice (witness or friend) is allowed
human.spec: Real voice, recorded on the day; no TTS, no voice changer
human.tones_note: none blocked, but keep dominant/pressuring delivery out (B18)
human.pace_control: Natural pace; 1-2 disfluencies allowed (B20); no scripted laughs (F142)
human.qa: Same transcript check; also flag any turn above 200 wpm

VOICE_RULES.note: direction.py keeps the §4 pace advice but never below a beat's gate sizing (vsp.timing.wps): the per-beat wpm in energy_curve is a floor

story-turn.text: a story turn: the {subject} flips the expectation the hook set up, then the payoff lands

character.text: a character: one recurring presenter trait or signature line viewers recognise next time

reaction-face.text: a spontaneous reaction face at the reveal (a real expression, never a pose)

hummable-hook.text: a hummable sonic hook: one real sound of the {subject} on the hook, repeated on the payoff

soft-pause.text: a pause, then a soft voice: about 0.5 s of silence before the payoff line, delivered softer

out-of-ordinary.text: one out-of-the-ordinary moment the {subject} causes (an unexpected angle or prop gag)

FINISH.candid_text: Candid finish: imperfection welcome (faint handheld, uneven natural light, one mid-sentence punch-in); deliberate roughness is this vibe's grammar (C6)
FINISH.clean_text: Clean finish: native grammar (real people, phone framing) with clean composition and good light; polish is fine in this vibe, never glossy stock

tiktok_shop.swap_why: Shop videos show real people; hands-only vibes swap to a people-visible one
do: a real person visible on screen (face and hands), not hands only
microphone in a quiet room and stabilised footage (tripod or gimbal)
on-screen text synced with speech
dont: TikTok-library music only: no general Sounds, no suggestive tracks, no AI-generated music
no AI voice claims: a synthetic voice never presents a Shop video
no still images standing in for the video
tiktok_shop.ai_note: AI persona: not eligible for the TikTok Shop lane (AI voice as presenter is banned there); post the TikTok cut without a Shop link, or re-voice with a real human for Shop

SET_TEMPLATES.clean-aesthetic: {place}, styled minimal: 1-3 props and negative space in the {subject}'s colour family (B19)
SET_TEMPLATES.hype-energy: a clean backdrop or bold colour wall in {place}, the {subject} in hand
SET_TEMPLATES.cozy-calm: {place} at dusk: blanket, mug, warm lamps
SET_TEMPLATES.expert-trust: {place} as a clean work surface with real tools; labels and readouts legible
SET_TEMPLATES.playful-comedic: {place}, with only the props the gag needs
SET_TEMPLATES.cinematic-premium: a seamless dark sweep (stone, marble or wet surface) for the hero shots, plus one context shot in {place}
SET_TEMPLATES.asmr-satisfying: a tidy surface in {place}, shot in close-up
SET_TEMPLATES.story-vlog: real locations across the day, with {place} as the anchor spot revisited every day
SET_TEMPLATES.before-after-reveal: {place}, locked off on the same marks for BEFORE and AFTER

NICHE_DO.beauty: true colour on skin and hair (no beauty filter); one texture close-up
NICHE_DO.fitness: show real effort (a real rep, real sweat); never a fresh-looking workout
NICHE_DO.food: steam, pour and texture close-ups carry food: shoot the food, not the cook
NICHE_DO.gadgets: the gadget does its job in the first second; screens and LEDs readable, never blown out
NICHE_DO.tools: the tool does its real job with hands in frame for scale
NICHE_DO.home: each item in its real spot in the room
NICHE_DO.wellness: calm, uncluttered frames; no health or outcome claims
NICHE_DO.automotive: inside the real car in daylight: fit against the seats and dash is the proof
NICHE_DO.pets: the animal's reaction is the proof: keep the pet in frame at its eye level
NICHE_DO.outdoors: real outdoor light and texture: show it working in the field, not on a table
NICHE_DO.finance: labels carry the numbers; no red in price graphics (B16)
NICHE_DO.education: one point per cut; labels carry the key numbers
NICHE_DO.commentary: face-first; cut on every new point
NICHE_DO.default: proof before pitch: the first frame shows the result or the thing working

IN_FRAME.product: the {subject} in frame from frame 0, shown more than once (Meta x Toluna)
IN_FRAME.showcase: each find in frame in its real spot, one find per cut
IN_FRAME.challenge: the day marker on screen on every day beat, with the same anchor spot each day
IN_FRAME.routine: the routine's real props in frame, in the order they are used
IN_FRAME.advice: the presenter's face or the worked example in frame; labels carry the numbers

HUMOR.rule: no jokes on proof, price or guarantee lines (humour lowers source credibility)

tiktok-cbp.claim: TikTok's creative guidance asks for a native, DIY look with real people rather than heavy polish

meta-toluna-2025.claim: In 100 Reels ads, everyday-people scenes were 1.5x and emoji 2.5x likelier to reach top-20% purchase intent (correlational)

system1-tiktok.claim: Showmanship (story, characters, a hummable tune, a pause) lifted conversion and brand memory; pure salesmanship cost brand awareness

xiao-2024.claim: Across 2,511 TikTok seller videos, shot count had an inverted-U effect on engagement

visual-matters-2026.claim: Aesthetic appeal raised credibility while production quality had no effect (preregistered, N=1,200)

li-xie-2020.claim: Professional-quality brand images raised engagement on Twitter and Instagram

calm-tts-2023.claim: Calm voice reads were rated above energetic ones, synthesized voices included

jtaer-2025-arousal.claim: Vocal arousal had an inverted-U effect on engagement while visual variation had a linear one

husain-2002.claim: Musical tempo moves arousal and mode moves mood

lowe-haws-2017.claim: Lower-pitched sound makes a product seem bigger

jtr-2023-voice.claim: Ad viewers preferred quieter, clearer voices

vanzant-berger-2020.claim: Persuaders get louder and vary their volume, which reads as confidence

vj-2024-intonation.claim: Falling intonation conveys confidence and helps strong arguments

eisend-2009.claim: Humour raises liking and attention but lowers source credibility (meta-analysis)

barta-2023.claim: Influencer humour on TikTok raised effectiveness through hedonic experience

asmr-2025.claim: Auditory ASMR raised voice credibility, sensory gratification and endorser liking

emac-2025-asmr.claim: Visual triggers and rubbing or crunching sounds drove engagement

ijhci-2024.claim: Human narrators out-persuaded AI narrators on story content

system1-grade-2026.claim: A story-congruent colour grade added up to +0.4 stars in a small regrade test

tiktok-ad-policy.claim: TikTok's ad policy bans misleading before/after content

tiktok-shop-2026.claim: TikTok Shop quality rules: TikTok-library music only, a microphone in a quiet room, stabilised footage, no AI voices in LIVE

tiktok-music-terms-2026.claim: TikTok's general Sounds are personal and non-commercial; AI music videos should not be used for endorsements

tiktok-cml-terms.claim: The Commercial Music Library is TikTok's only commercial music and is licensed for TikTok only

tiktok-cml-help.claim: Business accounts use the Commercial Music Library for every commercial post

ig-music-guidelines-2020.claim: The Meta Sound Collection may be used in Facebook and Instagram videos, on Meta platforms only

yt-upload-errors.claim: Shorts label music is licensed for personal use; commercial Shorts use the YouTube Audio Library

yt-audio-library.claim: YouTube Audio Library tracks are copyright-safe and monetizable; CC tracks need attribution

yt-ai-disclosure.claim: YouTube asks creators to label realistic AI-generated or altered content

studio-resonate-2025.claim: Human voices beat matched AI voices on implicit trust, and a 'this is AI' prime cut trust

wpp-2025.claim: AI voices matched human voices on attention and purchase intent; believed-human voices felt more relatable

jams-2026-vi.claim: Virtual influencers offer more novelty but less credibility than humans (meta-analysis)

jtaer-2026-avatar.claim: An AI avatar got more plays but fewer clicks in a field test

uva-vi-disclosure.claim: Prominent virtual-influencer disclosure lowered credibility more than subtle, integrated disclosure

mitchell-2011.claim: A face-voice realism mismatch reads as eerie

chbr-2024-uncanny.claim: Vocal uncanniness comes from deviating from typical human voices; good synthetic voices escape it
